outcome: intraoperative findings (e.g., difficulty in placental separation, placental bed sutures, emergency hysterectomy, blood transfusion)
pathological findings (for placenta accreta, increta, percreta)
cohort: 40 women who underwent cesarean section for placenta previa at Ain Shams University Maternity Hospital.
finding: Prenatal ultrasound is an effective screening tool for morbidly adherent placenta, and its simple parameters can be highly predictive.
mod_finding: The study details various intraoperative complications (e.g., difficulty in placental separation, placental bed sutures, emergency hysterectomy, blood transfusion) observed during cesarean sections for morbidly adherent placenta.
